Update, 5:55 p.m. ET: Apple Developer’s System Status page now lists the issue as resolved. The original story follows below.

Apple Developer’s System Status page confirms that App Store Connect is suffering from performance issues, as confirmed by multiple users on X. Here are the details.

Issue affects some developers

According to Apple Developer’s System Status page, App Store Connect started presenting performance issues at 9:00 a.m. ET today.

The status page doesn’t go into detail regarding what is actually happening, mentioning only that this is a “performance” issue that is affecting “some users.”

A quick search on X, however, shows developers encountering errors across multiple areas of App Store Connect while trying to manage their apps.

Earlier today, Apple’s System Status page also listed a Mac App Store issue that may have prevented some users from signing in, but it was quickly resolved.

Beyond listing the issue on its Developer System Status page, Apple has not shared any additional details on the App Store Connect’s partial outage. We will update this post if the company provides more information or marks the incident as resolved.

Have you run into issues with App Store Connect today? Let us know in the comments.
